metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Agent'[Agent],
			"Cost_per_run", '_Measures'[Cost per run],
			"Failure_rate", IGNORE('_Measures'[Failure rate]),
			"Avg_steps_per_run", IGNORE('_Measures'[Avg steps per run]),
			"Agent_cost_rank", IGNORE('_Measures'[Agent cost rank])
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Cost_per_run], 0, 'Agent'[Agent], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Cost_per_run] DESC, 'Agent'[Agent]

metrics.visualTitle: Model cost by month and model (USD)

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Date'[Year-Month],
			'Date'[Year-Month number],
			'Model'[Model],
			"Model_cost", '_Measures'[Model cost]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			201,
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Date'[Year-Month], 'Date'[Year-Month number]),
			'Date'[Year-Month number],
			1,
			'Date'[Year-Month],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Model'[Model])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(62, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'Model'[Model], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'Model'[Model],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'Model'[Model]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Date'[Year-Month number], 'Date'[Year-Month], [ColumnIndex]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Date'[Year-Month],
			'Date'[Year-Month number],
			"Cached_token_share", '_Measures'[Cached token share]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'Date'[Year-Month number], 1, 'Date'[Year-Month], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Date'[Year-Month number], 'Date'[Year-Month]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Model_cost", '_Measures'[Model cost],
		"Cost_per_run", '_Measures'[Cost per run],
		"Failure_rate", '_Measures'[Failure rate],
		"Avg_steps_per_run", '_Measures'[Avg steps per run],
		"Latency_p95_ms", '_Measures'[Latency p95 ms],
		"Cached_token_share", '_Measures'[Cached token share]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Model'[Model], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			"Model_call_count", '_Measures'[Model call count],
			"Latency_p95_ms", '_Measures'[Latency p95 ms],
			"Model_call_error_rate", '_Measures'[Model call error rate],
			"Cached_token_share", '_Measures'[Cached token share]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(502, __DS0Core, [IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 0, [Model_call_count], 0, 'Model'[Model], 1)

	VAR __DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals = 
		FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalRowTotal] = FALSE)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals,
		"MinCached_token_share", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Cached_token_share]),
		"MaxCached_token_share", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Cached_token_share])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, [Model_call_count] DESC, 'Model'[Model]

	VAR __DS0Core =
